audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive properties are absent from both layers. Maokai is untargetable for the whole of the Twisted Advance dash, and Sap Magic's heal cooldown is reduced every time Maokai is struck by an enemy spell, not only when he casts one. A third item is mislabelled: dontsFull[2] says 'Eat his R knockback', but Nature's Grasp roots — the knockback is Bramble Smash.
audit.why: The untargetable window is the reason a Cho'Gath loses Feast for nothing in this lane: Feast is a targeted, point-blank 80-second ultimate, and starting it while Twisted Advance is in flight simply wastes it. The Sap Magic detail inverts the poking advice — every stray Rupture or Vorpal Spikes tick that lands on him shortens his heal cooldown, so aimless chip does not grind a Maokai down, it feeds him. That is also the real argument for early Grievous Wounds here, which the page recommends without ever saying why.
audit.corrected: State the untargetable dash against Feast, state that your spells accelerate Sap Magic, and correct the Nature's Grasp label to a root.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Cho'Gath Levels 2, 3, First item and 2+ items and score Level 6 as Skill. The packet chart says Maokai at 2, 3 and 2+ items, Skill at First item, and Cho'Gath at 6 — and the content whys already say exactly that, row for row.
audit.why: The whys read 'he farms safely behind sapling poke and concedes you nothing' (Level 3, currently scored Cho'Gath), 'your one real kill threat and the stage you own outright' (Level 6, currently Skill), 'the cell is genuinely even' (First item, currently Cho'Gath) and 'his root utility out-values your single-target Feast' (2+ items, currently Cho'Gath). Every one of those four rows is scored against its own explanation, on a 47.62% matchup.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Skill, Maokai, Maokai, Skill, Cho'Gath, Skill, Maokai with ratings 5, 4, 4, 6, 7, 5, 4.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', and that is accurate — not one number appears in either layer, in a matchup whose entire advice is 'trade around Twisted Advance's cooldown'.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14s at rank 1 and only 525 range, so staying outside that distance removes the root entirely. Bramble Smash is 7s at rank 1 and 600 range. Sapling Toss is 18s at rank 1 and reaches 1100. Nature's Grasp is 130s at rank 1 and travels 3000 units.
audit.corrected: Put 14s/525, 7s, 18s/1100 and 130s/3000 into cooldowns, dosFull, dontsFull and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind' with no mechanism attached.
audit.why: Sap Magic is the heal, and it is on a cooldown that your own spells shorten. That makes Grievous Wounds better here than in most tank lanes, because a Cho'Gath's Vorpal Spikes and Rupture are constantly refreshing the thing he is trying to out-grind.
audit.corrected: Name Bramble Vest and Sap Magic, and say why.

audit.whatIsWrong: All three Critical Don'ts carry descriptions from other matchups, and one heading names the wrong ability.
audit.why: 'Fight in saplings' and 'Eat his R knockback' are explained with burn-your-W and whiff-your-Q text respectively.
audit.corrected: Give the saplings their 18s/1100 numbers and correct Nature's Grasp to a root.

edits.before: Two immobile tanks, but Maokai edges the opening because his saplings and Bramble Smash (Q) knockback let him chip you for free while you wait out a slow, telegraphed Rupture. Don't throw Q into auto range hoping to start a trade — he just saplings you back and the Carnivore-vs-Sap-Magic sustain race stays even. Last-hit with the tip of Q, eat the poke, and remember neither of you can actually kill here, so losing a little HP is fine.
edits.after: Two immobile tanks, but Maokai edges the opening because Sapling Toss and Bramble Smash (Q, 7s at rank 1) chip you for free while you wait out a slow, telegraphed Rupture. Don't throw Q into auto range hoping to start a trade — every spell of yours that strikes him also shortens Sap Magic's heal cooldown, so aimless poke feeds his sustain instead of grinding it. Last-hit at the tip of Q and accept the chip.

edits.before: Level 6 is your window and the one stage you genuinely own — Feast deals true damage that ignores all the armor and MR Maokai stacks, so a low Maokai gets executed where nothing else in your kit would finish a tank. Land Rupture into Feral Scream to knock him up and silence him for up to two seconds so he can't dash out with Twisted Advance, then look for R if he's under the execute threshold. Outside that 6 spike the lane flattens back into an even farm war.
edits.after: Level 6 is your window and the one stage you genuinely own — Feast is true damage that ignores every point of armour and MR Maokai stacks, so a low Maokai dies where nothing else in your kit finishes a tank. But he is untargetable for the whole Twisted Advance dash, so never start Feast while it is in flight. Land Rupture into Feral Scream first: a silenced Maokai cannot cast the dash at all, and the 80s ultimate then lands on a rooted target.

edits.before: Once both of you are full tank, Maokai reclaims the matchup — Twisted Advance (W) is a targeted root-dash engage that locks a carry for your whole team's follow-up, and his brush saplings control vision and chokes far better than your single-target Feast. You stay a teamfight titan and your Rupture knock-up into Feral Scream silence still peels for carries, but in a straight 5v5 his root utility out-values you. Win your own side lane stacking Feast rather than trying to outscale his engage head-to-head.
edits.after: Once both of you are full tank, Maokai reclaims the matchup — Twisted Advance (W) is a targeted root-dash that locks a carry, and Nature's Grasp is a 130-second wall of brambles rolling 3000 units to root a whole team at once. His saplings control brush and chokes far better than your single-target Feast. You stay a teamfight titan and Rupture into Feral Scream still peels for carries, but his root utility out-values you. Win your own side lane stacking Feast instead.
